The loop

Assess → Act → Prove

01

Assess

Upload 3–5 clear photos. Photo quality gates the pipeline first — then we measure only traits with a real signal.

02

Act

Every weak score unlocks paired recommendations ranked by effort and confidence. No low score without a next step.

03

Prove

Re-upload over time. We check lighting and angle consistency before comparing — so change isn’t a photo artifact.
